agent.text: v1: a spike in code. It reads the parsed tables (data/analysis/tables.json, aggregates.json in the finger-food repo; rebuild with analysis.py) and shows them: the tables and the links between them, the menu items and menu lines counted, and the Excel prices matched to the items. Nothing from the Excel is brought into the data. The matching of Excel rows to items is a guess by similar name (a score is shown): read it as a question, not as an answer. Near-duplicates are merged by name similarity (0.88): a switch shows the counts with and without the merge. Tables carry the names of the canonical ERD where it has them: proposal, moment, menu_line, menu_line_item, invoice, payment. menu_line_item holds the item as written (the text), since there is no catalog item yet: the counts group that text. invoice_lines, price_lines, price_list and documents have no table in the ERD.
